lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a geometric grid pattern, predominantly visible on the lateral and dorsal surfaces posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae running parallel to the spine, characterized by bright highlights on the upper ridge and sharp shadow transitions on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small high-luminance spots localized on the trailing edge and medial surface of the first dorsal fin.
